channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Heavy Storm Cuts Power, Grounds Planes Across US Northeast
item.description: A powerful nor’easter has knocked out power to thousands of homes and businesses in the US Northeast, grounding hundreds of flights and prompting state leaders to declare emergencies. Two weekend concerts by pop star Ed Sheeran at Gillette Stadium outside Boston were canceled as a precaution.

item.title: Prince Harry wants Earl Spencer for rumoured Princess Diana documentary project: Report
item.description: Prince Harry is reportedly exploring a documentary project about his late mother, Princess Diana, and wants her brother Earl Spencer involved. The reported plans come ahead of Diana’s 30th death anniversary in 2027, though no project has been confirmed.

item.title: Trump renews Russia-Ukraine peace push, urges Zelensky, Putin to ‘make a deal... settle’
item.description: Trump's call for both Zelensky and Putin to “settle” comes as the war enters another winter with no comprehensive peace agreement in place and renewed diplomatic efforts running alongside continued military escalation.

item.title: Billy Gardell, well-known for Bob Hearts Abishola, reveals why weight loss surgery ‘probably saved’ his life
item.description: Actor Billy Gardell has opened up about his 150-plus-pound weight loss, saying bariatric surgery in 2021 helped reverse his type 2 diabetes and “probably saved” his life.

item.title: ‘Because they’re dying’, ‘They have no money now’: Trump reveals why Iran wants Strait of Hormuz reopened
item.description: For now, the central disagreement remains over the sequence of steps: Tehran is seeking sanctions relief, an end to the blockade and a ceasefire before fully reopening the waterway, while Trump is demanding continued pressure on Iran and has rejected the proposal as currently structured.

item.title: Watch: Monkey’s unexpected visit to Ranchi liquor shop takes a sleepy turn after it drinks from bottle
item.description: A monkey entered a liquor shop at Ormanjhi’s Block Chowk in Ranchi, drank from a bottle and later fell asleep inside the premises, prompting a rescue team to intervene.

item.title: Jaishankar's UNGA address — ‘Our right to defend ourselves’ to ‘endless war must end’: 7 key takeaways
item.description: Jaishankar called for restraint in ongoing conflicts while arguing that terrorism and state-sponsored cross-border violence must face accountability.

item.title: Weather tomorrow 27 September: Very heavy rain in Uttarakhand, Himachal; snowfall likely | Check Delhi, UP, MP and more
item.description: Heavy rain is forecast for northern India on 27 September, particularly in Uttarakhand, Himachal Pradesh and western Uttar Pradesh.&nbsp;

item.title: Who is Mohibullah Ansari? IPS officer who failed Class 10, 12 pre-board exams and cracked IIT, set to receive US honour
item.description: IPS officer Mohibullah Ansari, who overcame early academic failures to study at IIT Delhi, will reportedly receive the Asian Hero Award 2026 for his policing and social welfare contributions. The award is presented by the Association of World Fair and Fest on December 13, 2026, in Florida.

item.title: Food safety vs public health: Maharashtra FDA chief Tukaram Mundhe calls for behaviour change
item.description: Mundhe said people frequently look at illnesses only from a healthcare perspective without considering whether the food and beverages they consume could be contributing to their health problems

item.title: S Jaishankar slams Pakistan at UNGA — says ‘serial practitioner of terrorism’ cannot claim immunity
item.description: While Jaishankar did not name Pakistan directly in his remarks, he was referring to the address delivered by Pakistan Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif at the UNGA yesterday. Sharif had raised issues including India-Pakistan tensions, Kashmir and the Indus waters in his speech.

item.title: Hurricane Nolo strengthens near Hawaii: When will the storm hit Big Island, how much rain is expected — latest updates
item.description: Tropical-storm conditions, defined by winds of 39 to 73 mph, were being reported across the Big Island, with gusty conditions also affecting some wind-prone areas of Maui County, Oahu and Kauai.

item.title: SIR row: BJP allies welcome Election Commission's clarification, accuse Opposition of spreading misinformation
item.description: Following the Election Commission's clarification, leaders like CM N Chandrababu Naidu and JD(U) working president Sanjay Jha defended its integrity and accused the opposition of spreading misinformation. They emphasised the importance of trust in democratic institutions.

item.title: ‘My boss says this is AI’: Indian MD in UAE gifts iPhone to employees; social media reacts to viral video
item.description: In a viral video, &nbsp;a UAE company director showcases employees unwrapping gifts with a twist: everyone receives an iPhone.&nbsp;

item.title: Trump faces Senate test in Georgia, North Carolina as GOP candidates trail Democrats in surveys
item.description: With Republicans defending their Senate majority and Democrats seeking the four seats needed to take control, the two races are becoming important tests.

item.title: Delhi, Maharashtra SIR: Election Commission extends claims, objections deadlines; check new dates
item.description: The Election Commission has extended the deadline for filing claims and objections in Delhi's electoral rolls revision to October 30. The final voter list is now set for December 4, with notices and claims disposal pushed to November 30, following a request from the Chief Electoral Officer.

item.title: What if your car’s fuel bill felt like ₹25 petrol? The hybrid tech behind Gadkari’s 100% ethanol car pitch
item.description: Nitin Gadkari advocates for ethanol-powered cars, highlighting their comparable costs to petrol at ₹25 per litre.&nbsp;

item.title: Suicide attack in Pakistan kills 12, injures 30 amid rising militant violence: Pakistani Taliban claims responsibility
item.description: A suicide bomber attacked a police checkpost in Dera Ismail Khan, killing 12 people. The Tehreek-e-Taliban Pakistan claimed responsibility.&nbsp;

item.title: FDA recalls 1.7 million pounds of sugar: Check if your brown or powdered sugar is affected
item.description: The FDA has classified a recall of nearly 1.7 million pounds of brown and powdered sugar as Class II after possible wheat kernel contamination. Products were distributed across eight US states, including Texas and Illinois.

item.title: Russia may intensify hybrid warfare against NATO in coming months, Denmark warns; Putin rejects claims
item.description: For now, the Danish assessment distinguishes between increased hybrid activity, which it expects in the coming months, and a full-scale attack on NATO, which it considers highly unlikely.

item.title: SIR: BLOs to visit homes of those issued notices, personal hearings only in exceptional cases; read full ECI statement
item.description: The Election Commission said SIR notices over unmapped entries or logical discrepancies will generally not require personal hearings, with BLOs visiting homes to collect documents. Hearings will be held only in exceptional cases, preferably online, it added.

item.title: 13 crore names deleted in SIR: Your name not on list? What is the process to get enrolled again?
item.description: Over 13 crore names were removed from draft voter lists during SIR across 30 states and Union Territories. Is yours one of those?

item.title: Nor’easter hits US Northeast: New Jersey roads flood as homes take on water and power cuts spread
item.description: A powerful nor’easter is battering the US Northeast with flooding, strong winds and heavy rain, leaving tens of thousands without power as coastal communities in New Jersey and Connecticut prepare for more severe conditions.

item.title: Trump’s nearly $1 billion funding cuts explained: What Congress approved and which programmes are affected
item.description: The White House says the move represents an effort to protect taxpayers and eliminate spending it considers unnecessary or harmful. The latest rescissions are likely to intensify the broader dispute between Trump's administration and Congress over who ultimately controls federal spending.

item.title: US-China AI hotline? Why Xi-Trump summit went beyond tariffs to ‘super intelligence’
item.description: Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi highlighted the positive developments in China-US relations following Xi's visit to Washington, emphasizing cooperation on hosting major economic summits and initiating dialogue on AI risks.&nbsp;

item.title: SIR orders unanimous, Form 6 changes upheld by Supreme Court: Election Commission issues statement amid dissent row
item.description: SIR row: The Election Commission confirmed all decisions on the electoral rolls revision were approved by its commissioners. They clarified that letters from two commissioners to the Cabinet Secretary were unrelated to policy or IT decisions.

item.title: India weather: INSAT-3DS captures dramatic shift as heavy clouds cover east, south; northwest turns clear; here's why
item.description: Satellite imagery reveals stark weather contrasts in India, with dense clouds over central and eastern regions while the northwest remains clear. An active deep depression contributes to rainfall, particularly in Odisha and Chhattisgarh, as the southwest monsoon begins to withdraw in the northwest.

item.title: Bangkok flood ‘disaster’: Heavy rain causes havoc; Homes, shops and roads are waterlogged | Watch
item.description: Bangkok has declared a state of disaster due to unprecedented rainfall of 487mm this September. Flooding affected 21 provinces, resulting in one death and widespread damage.&nbsp;

item.title: Maharashtra declares 265 talukas drought-hit; crop loan restructuring, power concessions announced
item.description: The measures include restructuring of crop loans, concessions on land revenue, postponement of recovery of agriculture-related loans and electricity bill relief for agricultural pumps in the affected areas

item.title: Suryakumar Yadav’s 2011 Toyota Fortuner gets stunning makeover in Mumbai; netizens call it ‘top-notch’ | Watch
item.description: Suryakumar Yadav has customised his sentimental yellow Toyota Fortuner at Mumbai's Autorounders. Surprised by the transformation, he praised the SUV as a ‘beast’, hinting at future projects with the workshop after resolving its long-standing issues.

item.title: Russia-Ukraine war: Moscow's decree forces pvt businesses to opt for air-defense systems to defend against drone attacks
item.description: Ukrainian drone strikes are increasingly affecting Russia’s economy, prompting businesses to lease or build air-defence systems and hire guards to counter drones. Moscow has also urged companies to protect themselves

item.title: US-China set up SI Dialogue to discuss AI incidents, weeks after Trump asked cos to maintain dominance over Beijing
item.description: The US and China have agreed to establish a communication channel for AI-related incidents and launch a Super Intelligence Dialogue. The move comes as Washington and Beijing seek to address AI risks while continuing to compete over the development of advanced technology.

item.title: At 5.5%, treasury yield on US govt 30-year debt reaches fresh high since 2004
item.description: The yield on US government 30-year debt reached fresh multiyear highs on the last day of a bruising week after a gauge of consumer sentiment exceeded economist estimates.

item.title: Railways to run 102 special trains for Diwali and Dussehra: Check routes, timings, and ticket booking details
item.description: These additional trains have been rolled out to ensure a seamless and comfortable journey for millions of travellers returning home for the holidays.

item.title: India slams Pak, says Islamabad has a 'long-standing practice of cross-border terrorism'; warns of consequences
item.description: India slammed Pakistan at the UNGA over cross-border terrorism and Kashmir, warning that continued terrorism would have consequences, while Pakistan raised the Kashmir issue and warned that any attempt to divert its share of Indus waters would be treated as an act of war.
